patch_description: Choose the cohort count by directly scoring every realizable balanced partition instead of rounding an independently optimal clique degree. For each cohort count, compute the population-weighted utility of its actual small and large cohort sizes using the existing overlapping-clique utility model. Strict comparison and descending enumeration retain smaller cohorts on ties, reducing unnecessary construction. This should better align formation and acceptance with achievable N=40 partitions, though the structural estimate may still understate transition costs and post-shock partition disagreement.
